The company, 4 consolidated subsidiaries and 6 non-consolidated subsidiaries make up the group, and its single segment is home delivery of prepared food ingredients. In the home delivery business, the consolidated subsidiary RIDE ON EXPRESS Co., Ltd. is responsible for the franchise headquarters functions and the operation of directly operated stores.
